picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: A 4.5% inflation print would upend rate-cut expectations and reprice bonds, mortgages, and real wages.

picks.question: Will Eurozone GDP growth in Q3 2026 be between 0.8% and 1.1%?
picks.why: Euro-area growth shapes ECB policy, the dollar-euro exchange rate, and global demand for traded goods.

picks.question: Will Partido Liberal (PL) hold the most seats in the Brazilian Chamber of Deputies after the 2026 election?
picks.why: Brazil's legislature drives fiscal rules and commodity policy in Latin America's largest economy.

picks.question: Will OpenAI’s market cap be $1.5T or greater at market close on IPO day by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: An OpenAI listing near $1.5 trillion would test how public markets price the AI buildout.

picks.question: Will Alibaba have the best Chinese AI model at the end of September 2026?
picks.why: Tracks whether Chinese labs keep pace, informing export-control debates and global compute investment.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state wealth tax would be a live experiment in taxing mobile capital and measuring migration.
